contractNotes: The two observed initialize call sites both set experimentalApi:true; this fixture does not establish a response profile.
The probe parses initialize.userAgent with /\/([^\s]+)/; when it does not match, the derived version is undefined.
The client calls client.notify("initialized", void 0), so the params member is OMITTED from the frame entirely rather than sent as null. A replay must omit params, not send params:null.
The probe returns early when account is absent and requiresOpenaiAuth is true; otherwise it continues to skills/list and model/list.
Issued concurrently with model/list via Effect.all with unbounded concurrency.

pagination.loop: requests {} initially and { cursor } when cursor is truthy, assigning response.nextCursor after every response until it is falsy
contractNotes: The observed loop terminates when response.nextCursor is falsy.

scopeImplication: The extracted probe path sends initialize, initialized, account/read, then—unless it returns early for missing account with requiresOpenaiAuth—concurrent skills/list and paginated model/list. This static extraction does not show the current behavior of a live GJC server.
